en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about the girl captured from the land of the Polytheism, so she becomes a Muslim. So someone was sought who could cut her (genitals), but we were not able upon (finding) a woman. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘As for the Sunnah regarding the circumcision, it is upon the men, and it is not upon the women’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from abu Basir who has said the following:

“I once asked abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a girl who is taken as captive from the pagan’s land then she becomes Muslim and she is asked for Khafd but we are not able against a woman. He (the Imam) said, ’Circumcision is for men and not for women.”’ (It a is reference to lowering or reducing female clitoris )
